description: Use this for the key figures of a Chilean issuer's IFRS financial statements as filed with the CMF: revenue, operating income, net income, total assets, liabilities, equity, cash, financial debt and cash flows, for the latest filed quarter (or period, e.g. 2026-06) with the comparative columns, in full currency units, plus headline figures in USD. Consolidated when available. include_all_lines=true adds every published line. Labels stay as the CMF's IFRS taxonomy labels (label_es). Access: open to anonymous agents (rate-limited); a free AndesPass key raises the limit.

include_all_lines.description: true adds every line of every statement as published (long).
include_all_lines.title: Include All Lines

period.description: Quarter end as yyyy-mm (e.g. 2026-06); omit for the latest filed.
period.title: Period

rut.description: The issuer's RUT (Chilean tax id), e.g. 61.808.000-5.
rut.title: Rut

name: cmf_financials
title: Chilean issuer IFRS figures
